sentences.en: The successful concert tour established her reputation as a singer.
sentences.zh: 这次成功的巡回演唱会确立了她作为歌手的声誉。

sentences.en: The police established where he was when the crime occurred.
sentences.zh: 警方确定了犯罪发生时他的位置。

sentences.en: They have run this small hotel since it was established.
sentences.zh: 自从这家小旅馆建立以来，他们一直在经营它。

senses.zh: 已建立的,已设立的,已制定的,确定的v.建立( establish的过去式和过去分词),确定,植物学使（植物）定植,使成为
